name: Shropshire Hills Conservation Fund

funder.name: Shropshire Hills National Landscape (Shropshire Hills Landscape Trust)

summary: Small grants of £500 to £2,000 for practical projects that conserve or enhance the landscape, wildlife or heritage of the Shropshire Hills National Landscape, run as a round with an expression of interest stage.

steps: Discuss the project idea with the fund before full application

eligibility.rule: Project shows a clear public benefit.
Has applied in fewer than three consecutive years immediately before this round
Seeks funding for work yet to be done

calls.label: Conservation Fund round, full applications by 8 March 2027

status.quote: Deadline for expression of interest is 15th February 2027.

deadline.quote: Deadline to complete the full application by Monday 8th March 2027.

calls.note: Expression of interest is due by 15 February 2027, before the full application.

applicant_types.quote: Public, private, voluntary sector, Town and Parish Councils, and community groups can apply, along with individuals and businesses

geography.quote: Conserving and enhancing the natural beauty, landscape, wildlife or heritage of the Shropshire Hills.

access.quote: Complete a short Project Ideas Form.

window.quote: Deadline for expression of interest is 15th February 2027.

effort.quote: Complete a short Project Ideas Form.
Deadline to complete the full application by Monday 8th March 2027.
Deadline for expression of interest is 15th February 2027.
When we have received and read your form we will be in touch to discuss your project in more detail.
Trustees from the Shropshire Hills Landscape Trust will meet to discuss the projects and award grants on Monday 15th March 2027.

co_finance_required.quote: Grants can be of up to 75% and match funding can be made up of in kind and volunteer time contributions as well as cash.

eligibility.quote: but in all cases the project must show a clear public benefit.
There is a consecutive 3-year limit on applying to the Fund.
The Fund cannot grant aid anything retrospectively. Preparation work may be done, but costs incurred before the date of the grant offer letter cannot be claimed or used as match funding.

co_finance.quote: Grants can be of up to 75% and match funding can be made up of in-kind and volunteer time contributions as well as cash.

after_award.quote: A short, written report with photographs is required at the end of the project showing how the work met the aim(s) and delivered public benefits.
